name: stripes
title: Diagonal Stripes
description: Bold black and white diagonal stripes slide across the frame.
useWhen: A bold graphic backdrop for a punchy title, a sale or a transition card.
Black-and-white or two-color motion that needs no image assets.
avoidWhen: You want soft, calm color: use shader-mesh-gradient.
Text sits directly on the stripes at small sizes: put it on a plain panel.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Stripes
variables.description: How many stripe pairs fit across the shorter side of the frame.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: Blur on the stripe edges. 0 is hard.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it if edges look soft.
